### ① Derived judgments

The seat's A/B/T/H table (hotcrm `d4ffe99`, H = 0) matches. Holds.

So in the four designers `collaboration` was always `null`: every removed line is a `collaboration?.…` call, a `broadcastOp` that returned on `!collaboration`, a `collaboration?.isConnected &&` chip, or the matching dependency-array entry. No other line of the four designers moves (hunks read). Holds.
- **`useConfirmDialog` stays as a module.** Seven designers import it (`AppCreationWizard`, `DataModelDesigner`, `FieldDesigner`, `ObjectManager`, `PageDesigner`, `ProcessDesigner`, `ReportDesigner`); only the entry line and the README lines go; `hooks/index.ts` keeps its line and has no importer. Holds.
- **`VersionHistory` had no renderer.** In-package non-test references are its own module, the components barrel, one comment and the entry; the module, its test and the barrel lines go together with `VersionHistoryProps` / `VersionHistoryEntry`. Keep rule 3 (no kept entry export's declared signature names a retired type) holds: neither type appears outside its module and sub-barrel. Holds.
- **Tests moved truthfully.** `ariaLabelNames.zh-12145` loses the `VersionHistory` region and anchors the zh wait on the minimap image it still asserts; undo / redo / minimap stay checked against both packs. The i18n aria-label census drops the two `Collaboration active` rows whose literals this diff deletes; the census stays a true backlog. Holds.
- Field security: none in reach; nothing withheld.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/plugin-designer` **patch** with `!`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `**BREAKING**` banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/plugin-designer#useConfirmDialog, @object-ui/plugin-designer#VersionHistory)` naming exactly the two operands that were published (the collaboration names left the entry in #29388 and are not operands), and a FROM → TO "no replacement" line per name with the fix (`ConfirmDialog` is still exported, checked on the entry). Level and marker are right: an entry narrowing with no protocol change ships `patch` and carries breaking-ness in the banner and the disposition (AGENTS.md step 3; `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` level axis), the shape #29388 used.
- **Must-fix — the declaration line is wrong.** The changeset and the PR body both read `Clause-②: yes` with no arm. By the fleet's one reader (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` L111–117) a bare `yes` declares **a widening** ("`yes` / `yes (widening)` — a widening … both take at least `minor`"); the breaking-but-not-widening form is `no (narrowing)`, "the whole point of the arm", written for exactly the #16296 class where a narrowing shipped with every gate green. This diff widens nothing: it retires two entry exports and deletes dead code. Both lines must read `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, as #29388's changesets do (`25921-plugin-designer-internal-helpers-off-entry.md`, `25921-collaboration-zero-consumer-exports.md`). The `(narrowing)` arm is also what the dogfood-battery obligation hangs on; the battery was run anyway (green on `d7514fc8`), so nothing else moves. The local gates passed with the bare `yes` because they read breaking-ness from the `!` and the marker, not from the arm; that is why the line has to be right by hand.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not Tier H: no governed path. Tier S as claimed; the seat lands after the fix and a re-review of the new head, which only needs the two lines compared.
- The PR body's Tests section still names `d7514fc8` as the head the suites ran on; `681e6c7a` adds only the aria-census row deletions, re-run by the dev (52 files / 472 tests). The seat's ACCEPT names the final head; the seat already knows.

### ④ Design judgment

- `src/index.tsx`: the hooks comment now lists the confirm-dialog hook among the module-local internals and drops the provider sentence; truthful on this head. `README.md` and the `package.json` description stop teaching collaboration. `useDesignerTranslation.ts` keeps the i18n comment accurate. Holds.
- The four designers read cleaner for the deletion; no dependency array lost a live entry (each removed entry is `collaboration` or `broadcastOp`). Holds.
- Changeset body: Before / what stays / what leaves, two FROM → TO lines. Holds once the declaration line is corrected.

One must-fix (② — both `Clause-②` lines to `no (narrowing)`). No should-fix.
